data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 asserts that sustained flags arise from an adjudication-ritual selection function that biases the sample toward confirmations, yet it provides no commitments or evidence to substantiate this causal claim. The artifact is essentially an unevidenced assertion: it describes a selection-bias mechanism (the harness filtering for artifacts where falsificationist commitments trigger) without citing any data about the harness's filtering criteria, the rate of confirmations vs. refutations, or any property of the sample that would demonstrate bias. Under an audit standard (§11.3), a claim that sustained flags are artifacts of selection bias rather than genuine critic findings must itself be falsifiable and supported; SRC_001's bare assertion with zero commitments cannot be audited, substantiated, or distinguished from a post hoc rationalization.
